name: steam-power-1-2
description: Offshore pump + 1 boiler + 2 steam engines: up to 1.8 MW. Burns up to 0.45 coal/s at full load (a burner inserter feeds the boiler from the coal input tile: end a coal belt there or put a chest of coal there).
placement: must sit on a shore: stamp it with anchor='offshore-pump' at an offshore_pump_spots entry from find name=water, rotation=<that spot's direction> (the pump faces the water). The rest needs 12x6 tiles of land behind the pump.

inputs.what: coal: end a coal belt on, or put a chest of coal at, this tile

outputs.what: electricity up to 1.8 MW: wire your poles to the small pole on this tile
